title: On quantitative aspects of trace polynomials
summary: By the classic results of Fricke and Klein, for every word $w$ in the free group $F(a,b)$ there exists a unique integer \it{trace polynomial} $f_w(x,y,z)\in Z[x,y,z]$ such that $Tr(w(A,B))=f_w(Tr A,Tr B,Tr AB)$. for all $A,B\in SL(2,C)$. We study quantitative aspects of trace polynomials. We prove an exact formula for the leading homogeneous part of $f_w$ for every nontrivial cyclically reduced word $w\in F(a,b)$.
